trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may read the global list of configured GitHub Enterprise endpoints (the Endpoint list in GitHubConfiguration) is decided in each descriptor form-fill handler that renders it: Jenkins.MANAGE when there is no item ancestor, Item.EXTENDED_READ when an @AncestorInPath Item is supplied.

landing_point.why: The branch-source navigator is the form where an API endpoint is picked from the globally configured GitHub Enterprise servers; a reader of the summary lands on its doFillApiUriItems / getPossibleApiUriItems, which is where the fix puts the guard.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The SCM Source dropdown is only rendered from a job's configure page, so anyone who reaches it already holds Item/CONFIGURE on that job, and its text is just the shared helper's output plus an extra loop of its own that needs no separate check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The form fills must keep returning the full endpoint list to an item-scoped user who can configure the folder or job (Item.CONFIGURE implies Item.EXTENDED_READ) so a folder admin can still pick a GHE server; copying the neighbouring idiom in the same class (@POST body plus an unconditional Jenkins.get().checkPermission(Jenkins.MANAGE)) blanks the picker for exactly those users.

O6_input_shapes: caller with no item ancestor (context == null): root/global configuration or new-item page -> Jenkins.MANAGE
caller with an @AncestorInPath Item (folder or job configuration page): Item.EXTENDED_READ

third entry point that only wraps the shared helper through a static import (GitHubAppCredentials.java:3) and a second, duplicated inline copy of the loop (GitHubSCMSource.java:2242-2250), both removed/delegated by the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Descriptor getter isApiUriSelectable() answers any Overall/Read caller whether at least one GHE endpoint is configured, unguarded and untouched by the fix (existence oracle, no URL returned)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It returns only a boolean, not an endpoint URL, and the jelly needs it to decide whether to render the picker at all; the advisory is about enumerating URLs.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ApiRateLimitChecker.RateLimitCheckerAdapter writes the first configured endpoint's API URL into the server log through a LogTaskListener at INFO when no per-thread checker is set
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a diagnostic log line for administrators, only fires on the github-api fallback path when no checker is configured for the thread, and never reaches a build log readers with ordinary job permissions.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a doFillApiUriItems / apiUri picker on the SSH checkout trait descriptor
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Trait descriptors are configured on items and this one already carries the identical 'context == null ? Jenkins.MANAGE : Item.EXTENDED_READ' guard for its credentials fill, so a maintainer adding an endpoint picker here would copy that guard or plausibly forget it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a doFillEndpointItems / doCheckEndpoint on the global GitHubConfiguration descriptor
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The global config page already requires Jenkins.MANAGE (GitHubConfiguration.java:238-242), so a maintainer would add an endpoint fill there with no guard, forgetting that descriptor methods are individually addressable.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an app-credential form fill that offers the configured GHE servers as choices
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This descriptor already exposes form-fill/validation endpoints for app-scoped data without any item-context guard.

O9_family: missing authorization (CWE-862) leading to information exposure of globally configured GitHub Enterprise endpoint URLs

O10_build.toolchain: Maven, jenkins plugin parent 6.2122.v70b_7b_f659d72, packaging hpi, jenkins.version 2.539 (baseline 2.528; Java 17 toolchain), spotless check enabled
O10_build.project_tests: GitHubSCMNavigatorTest.doFillScanCredentials (src/test/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/github_branch_source/GitHubSCMNavigatorTest.java:528-582) is the existing permission-test template for these form fills; GitHubAppCredentialsDescriptorTest.java:40-74 already covers the neighbouring SECURITY-3702 descriptor endpoint at URL level; EndpointTest.java:56-92 covers endpoint validation. The fix's own test only manipulates GitHubConfiguration and needs no network; the wider suite uses in-process WireMock stubs.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the SECURITY-3702 idiom from the same class (@POST + Jenkins.get().checkPermission(Jenkins.MANAGE), GitHubAppCredentials.java:839-848) into the navigator's doFillApiUriItems: it blanks the picker for folder configurators and leaves the source's duplicated inline list at GitHubSCMSource.java:2242-2250 open.

out_of_scope_notes: Sibling advisory SECURITY-3702 (GitHubAppCredentials.DescriptorImpl.doTestConnection) is already fixed at the pinned commit (GitHubAppCredentials.java:839-848, tests at GitHubAppCredentialsDescriptorTest.java:40-74); noted only as an idiom a solver may copy, not pursued.
The github plugin's own GitHubServerConfig listing is a different repository and was not examined.
